svg.title: The six Holo Core states
svg.desc: Six 3D particle forms, one per orb state: a sphere for idle, a wave sphere for listening, a torus for thinking, pulsing rings for speaking, a spiked star for alert and a double helix for learning. Each one turns in 3D.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: When ELLIOT changes state, every particle flies to its place in the next form.
